profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Google

positions.title: Eta Kappa Nu Member
positions.description: Tutoring Committee member. I participate in holding review sessions for undergraduate electrical engineering and computer science courses as well as holding regular office hours for students to come in for personal tutoring.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description: Undergraduate Security Researcher for Professor Dawn Song. Currently, I'm developing a web-crawling application that mines third-party Android application markets using Python and the HTML parsing library, Beautiful Soup.

positions.title: Open Computing Facility Volunteer
positions.description: Maintained UC Berkeley's Open Computing Facility which offers students free access to computers and printing for scholarly purposes by distributing free accounts and holding regular office hours.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Currently developing a web application using Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy over MySQL, and Twitter Bootstrap to facilitate talent management at LinkedIn. 

I am involved in frontend development and prototyping, but my main responsibilities are in the backend.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
One of the primary developers for the open source project Warewulf, a high-performance computing provisioning system. Specifically, coded the many-tiered network monitoring system using C, TCP and UDP sockets, an SQLite3 database, and the JSON-C formatting library.

Source code available at warewulf.lbl.gov.

projects.title: ParaTweet
projects.description: A Twitter content similarity engine which gives users suggestions for who to follow based on the content that one consumes. The app uses cosine similarity on vectors of tweets to determine who a user would be likely to follow. Implemented in Python using Flask, NumPy, NLTK, MongoDB, Gunicorn, and Nginx.
